1	# WP-005: Integration Tests for Auto-Update Behavior
     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	Make the GUI project detail page fully dynamic by adding periodic polling for all project-related data (WP statuses, synthesis availability, project status, health badge) and fix the orchestrator runs section to update without flicker or scroll position loss by using targeted DOM patching instead of full innerHTML rebuilds.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Implement integration tests that verify the assembled auto-update behavior: DOM element identity preservation during polling, synthesis auto-reveal, inline edit preservation, polling mode handoff, route navigation cleanup, and non-regression of modal/archive/resume flows under active polling.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `mcp-server/tests/gui/project-detail-auto-update.test.ts` — new integration test file
    14	- `mcp-server/tests/gui/project-detail-runs.test.ts` — additional integration tests in existing file
    15	
    16	## Deliverables
    17	
    18	- `project-detail-auto-update.test.ts` with integration tests:
    19	  - Simulate polling tick where a WP pipeline stage badge transitions (e.g., `qa: IN_PROGRESS` → `PASS`) and assert badge text/class update in the existing row without replacing the table element or row node (`===` identity preserved)
    20	  - Simulate polling tick where `synthesis_generated` flips to `true` and assert the synthesis row becomes visible without full page rerender or loss of inline editor state
    21	  - Simulate polling tick where project status changes (e.g., `IN_PROGRESS` → `COMPLETE`) and assert status badge text/class updates in place
    22	  - Simulate polling tick where health overview changes and assert health badge text/class updates in place
    23	- `project-detail-runs.test.ts` with additional integration tests:
    24	  - Active inline title edit remains mounted and input value/focus are preserved across poll ticks with data-only updates
    25	  - Resume-triggered polling handoff (`combined` → `resume` → `combined`) keeps a single active interval and preserves runs-section update continuity
    26	  - Route leave/return clears and re-registers exactly one polling interval, with no duplicate updates after navigation back to project detail
    27	  - Reset modal and archive/unarchive flows remain functional under active polling (no stale handlers, no unexpected DOM replacement)
    28	
    29	## Dependencies
    30	
    31	- WP-001 — DOM Patch Functions
    32	- WP-002 — State Snapshot Helper and Diff Logic
    33	- WP-003 — Combined Poll Function and Polling Mode State Machine
    34	- WP-004 — Orchestrator Runs Flicker-Free DOM Patching and Scroll Preservation
    35	
    36	## Acceptance Criteria
    37	
    38	1. All tests in `project-detail-auto-update.test.ts` pass
    39	2. All new tests in `project-detail-runs.test.ts` pass
    40	3. Tests use the shared GUI jsdom bootstrap pattern documented in `mcp-server/tests/gui/README.md`
    41	4. At least one test verifies DOM element identity preservation (strict `===` reference check on table row or badge element before and after a poll tick)
    42	5. At least one test verifies that inline edit input value and focus state survive a data-only poll update
    43	6. At least one test verifies single-interval invariant across combined↔resume mode transitions
    44	
    45	## Active Pipeline Stages
    46	
    47	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    48	
    49	## Estimated Complexity
    50	
    51	Medium
    52	
    53	## Notes
    54	
    55	This WP depends on WP-001, WP-002, WP-003, and WP-004 — it tests the assembled behavior of all prior implementation WPs. Tests should mock `API.getProject`, `API.getWorkPackageOverview`, `API.getProjectHealth`, and `API.orchestratorGetQueue` to simulate polling responses. The existing `project-detail-runs.test.ts` file already exists and has jsdom integration test infrastructure — new tests should follow the existing patterns in that file. Documentation pipeline stage for this WP should update `mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/file-tree.md` with the new test file (`project-detail-auto-update.test.ts`) and update `mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md` with the combined polling mode, `combined`↔`resume` handoff rules, and incremental runs/status patch behavior versus structural rerender fallback. The changelog entry (`mcp-server/changelog.md`) documenting the auto-update feature and flicker fix should also be added during this WP's documentation stage.
